caveats: No marine heatwaves detected: in this region summer 2004 SST stayed mostly below the 1992-2002 90th-percentile threshold (median SST-threshold -2.94 K; max exceedance +1.02 K on 2004-08-01; longest consecutive hot run in any cell was 2 days, below the 5-day MHW minimum), so no per-cell MHWs, no active days and no regional events. Per the method, pools include extension days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 around the baseline edges; day-of-year mapping is by month/day (31 Dec always 366, 1 Mar always 61). Sea cells = 3303 of 3600 (finite on all 92 target days); grid points at 0.02 deg spacing inside the inclusive bounds (54.18..55.36 N, 13.26..14.44 E).
